policy: All 30 slides are 100% native objects. Zero raster images, therefore zero cropping or aspect defects by construction.
rationale: The brief reported images overlapping and mis-cropped in the prior version. Native geometry removes that failure mode entirely rather than re-cropping assets.

regions.note: Concentric ellipses and vertical rules on midnight. No bitmap.
Midnight field, cyan rule, part number and title.
Numeral size scales to tile width so values never wrap.
No legend; values sit above each column per the design system.
Start and end values labelled directly; clearer than four crossing lines.

image_generation: Not invoked. No slide met the GENERATE verdict: the cover and dividers are served by deterministic native geometry, which is stronger here because the brief's defect was image handling.
